deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Use a DAO KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Coordinate proposal evaluation, feedback, transparent fund distribution, and outcome tracking through the DAO.
Use an independent council and multisig administrator to receive treasury withdrawals, hold funds before deployment, validate milestones, and oversee disbursements.
request.what: Create and continue the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders focused on Vision 2030 KPI growth.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is intended to allocate capital to builders who can drive Cardano growth in monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Funded projects are required to track core KPIs of monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO has built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 added 18 new DAO members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal says official Cardano developer documentation describes CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to on-chain activity, users, and TVL.

An independent council composed of dRep DAO members would receive treasury withdrawals, hold funds before deployment, and oversee disbursement according to milestones in a referenced milestone and budget document.
Any ADA held by the administrator before disbursement would be held in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The CB DAO says it returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction URL.

summary: The proposal describes a continuation or scaling of the Cardano Builder DAO as a KPI-driven, smart contract-governed funding pathway for Cardano builders, but the anchor text does not state the requested ADA amount or deadline and relies heavily on proposer-stated track-record claims with several external references.
